golden hour nights

coming after the pilot — nothing is scheduled yet. sometimes the lesson is in a room, with people. we won't run the night. we'll point you to people who do.

golden hour nights will be gatherings in your city — a courtyard, a rooftop, a hall, a living room — hosted by institutions and organizers we've checked out, around sunset, around a reading, some music, some food. one door or many. you'll find them in the Together tab once they start, with an invite that goes out through the tools people already use.

who hosts

temples, churches, mosques, synagogues, gurdwaras, meditation centers, and organizers with a track record. every host will be checked before they're listed. every event will be 18+. see Safety & hosts.

what they're not

not a service. not a recruitment drive. not a networking event. nobody's converting anyone; nobody's selling anything. you come, you sit, you listen, you eat, you leave better than you came.

want to host one?

if you run a space or a community and want to hold a night, we'd love to hear from you when we open hosting — see Contact.

start now. it's free.
